# Luna

> Luna is a private menstrual cycle tracker. Your cycle, symptoms and notes
> stay encrypted on your own device, so you can understand your cycle and see
> what may come next, without an account and without a server.

Category: menstrual cycle tracker and wellness companion. Non-medical: Luna
records what you enter and shows estimates back; it does not diagnose, screen
or give medical advice, and it is not a contraceptive.

Best for: anyone who wants to track their period, flow, symptoms, mood and
basal body temperature privately, and to see cycle predictions, a fertile
window and trends over time.

Not for: medical assessment, diagnosis, or contraception. Predictions are
estimates computed from the data you enter, and they may be inaccurate.

## What it offers

- Period and flow logging (spotting, light, medium, heavy) on a calendar.
- A daily log for symptoms, mood, energy and basal body temperature, plus
  your own notes.
- Cycle predictions, fertile window and ovulation estimates based on your
  personal history.
- Calendar, cycle history and insights: average cycle and period length,
  regularity and trends over recent cycles.
- Four tracking modes: regular cycles, trying to conceive, pregnancy and
  perimenopause.
- Optional reminder notifications for your period, your fertile window or
  your pill, scheduled locally on the device.
- Encrypted backup and restore (protected by your PIN), and a CSV export for
  your doctor, generated on your device.
- PIN lock, and a wipe that erases everything in a few taps.
- Your entries stay on your device. There is no account, no advertising, no
  analytics and no third-party tracking, and nothing is sent to a server.

## Platforms

iOS, Android and web (luna.macaron-software.com, running in the browser).
The web interface is available in 46 languages, with right-to-left support
for Arabic, Persian, Hebrew and Urdu; where a translation is incomplete,
English is shown. The iOS app ships in English and French; the Android app
in English.

## Device integrations

- Apple Health (HealthKit, iOS): optional and opt-in. Luna can read and write
  menstrual cycle and basal body temperature data with Apple Health. The data
  stays on your device under Apple's HealthKit rules, and access can be
  revoked at any time in iOS Settings.
- Health Connect (Android): optional and opt-in, same scope. Access can be
  revoked at any time in Android Settings.
- iCloud (iOS): optional and opt-in sync to your own private iCloud account
  (CloudKit, end-to-end encrypted record fields). No server of ours is involved.
